title: Signed Saturating Adder
constraints: `a`, `b` and `sum` are two's-complement signed values in the range −128 … 127.
When the true sum is above 127, `sum = 127` (0x7F). When it is below −128, `sum = −128` (0x80).
hints: Overflow in two's complement: both operands have the same sign and the result has the other sign.
Or sign-extend both operands to 9 bits and add: overflow happens when bits 8 and 7 of the 9-bit result differ.
The saturation value depends only on the sign of the operands (or bit 8 of the 9-bit sum).
